data.explanation: This is an appointment confirmation from a radiology practice for an MRI scan of your lower spine, as referred by your family doctor. Bring your health insurance card, the referral, and any earlier scans you may have. Remove metal objects and magnetic-stripe cards before the scan. If you have a pacemaker or other implants, call the practice beforehand. If you cannot make it, cancel at least 24 hours in advance so the slot can be given to someone else; no action is otherwise needed before the appointment date.
